Uses of Class
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa.MfaAuthorizationManager

Packages that use MfaAuthorizationManager
Package
Description
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit
OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628) for input-constrained clients, such as a command line tool: the protocol customizer that wires the device authorization and verification endpoints, the guard that applies the multi-factor policy and the limit on the attempts to the verification endpoint, and the verification page.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa
Multi-factor authentication orchestration.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott
One-time token authentication: e-mail and SMS codes and magic links as a primary sign-in method and as a second factor, the per-channel factors, the rate limits, the providers and filters, and the phone management API and account page.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.passkeys
Passkeys (WebAuthn): the factor, the chain wiring, the login and second-factor fragments, the account API and the account page.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.social
Social login (identity brokering) through external identity providers: Google, Microsoft Entra ID, Apple and GitHub.
